summary: Tested email preview functionality for admin panel. Fixed a critical JSX syntax error in Admin.js where EmailPreviewModal was placed outside the return statement. All 7 backend API tests pass and all 8 frontend UI tests pass.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/weekly-summary returns subject, html, and recipient_count
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/weekly-summary requires authentication (401 without auth)
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/new-journey/{journey_id} returns subject, html, and recipient_count
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/dream-funded/{journey_id} returns subject, html, and recipient_count
Backend: Preview (GET) and Send (POST) endpoints are properly separated
Frontend: Click 'Resumo Semanal' button (data-testid='send-weekly-summary-btn') opens EmailPreviewModal
Frontend: EmailPreviewModal shows email HTML content (data-testid='email-preview-content')
Frontend: EmailPreviewModal shows recipient count and 'Confirmar e Enviar' button (data-testid='email-preview-send')
Frontend: EmailPreviewModal has 'Cancelar' button that closes modal (data-testid='email-preview-cancel')
Frontend: 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' button (data-testid='announce-dream-btn') opens dropdown
Frontend: Dropdown shows journey selector with 7 active journeys to announce
Frontend: Selecting a journey from dropdown opens EmailPreviewModal for that journey
Frontend: Inside JourneyEditForm Config tab, 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' button opens preview modal instead of sending directly
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Admin.js line 2748-2761 - EmailPreviewModal was placed outside the JSX return block causing 'Unexpected token' error. Moved it inside the root div element.
FIXED: Admin.js onSent callback - Changed from undefined fetchJourneys() to proper axios.get() call to reload journeys after email is sent.
EmailPreviewModal.js correctly uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML to render email HTML preview
All preview endpoints properly require admin authentication
Preview endpoints return consistent structure: {subject, html, recipient_count}
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email preview functionality fully working. Key data-testids: email-preview-modal, email-preview-content, email-preview-send, email-preview-cancel, send-weekly-summary-btn, announce-dream-btn, announce-select-dropdown, send-new-journey-email-{journey_id}, send-funded-email-{journey_id}. Backend preview endpoints: GET /api/admin/emails/preview/weekly-summary, GET /api/admin/emails/preview/new-journey/{journey_id}, GET /api/admin/emails/preview/dream-funded/{journey_id}

features_verified.details: Click 'Resumo Semanal' button opens EmailPreviewModal with subject, HTML, and recipient count
Dropdown shows 7 active journeys, selecting one opens preview modal for new journey announcement
Config tab shows 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' button that opens preview modal instead of sending directly
Modal has title, subject, HTML content, recipient count, Cancel and 'Confirmar e Enviar' buttons with proper data-testid attributes
All 3 preview endpoints return {subject, html, recipient_count} and require admin auth
